summary: Plan created: 5 phases, 4 hours, waves [[1,2],[3],[4],[5]]. Built on the research finding that overturns the task's lock-contention hypothesis -- no defect exists in task-lock.sh or run-all.sh, and neither is modified. Phase 1 isolates test-validate-return-meta.sh from the live specs/ tree via a scratch fixture repo plus REPO_ROOT override (replacing the archived specs/052_* path). Phase 2 corrects test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh Group 2 to skill_cleanup()'s documented two-file contract and adds a positive control that .return-meta.json survives. Phase 3 adds scripts/lint/lint-live-specs-path.sh with a both-polarity fixture suite and manifest registration. Phase 4 writes the never-touch-the-live-tree rule into context/standards/shell-script-testing.md. Phase 5 executes the task's acceptance criterion -- 10 consecutive run-all.sh runs under concurrent load, identical results -- with the deploy-staleness confounder separated by diffing source-store against deployed copies before measuring and re-measuring after any deploy.
